A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

The videos Hacker News keeps recommending, broadcast 24/7 on channels. Same schedule for everyone.

Why it drew attention

The collected source record shows 347 points, 68 comments, and published 2026-11-03.

  • Comments at collection: 68 — official record
  • Points at collection: 347 — official record
  • Author: dsalzman — official record
  • Discussion text: I saw HackerTube ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50319510 ) a few days ago, the YouTube videos HN keeps recommending, pulled from 19 years of comments. It made me want to flip through them instead of picking, so I built a TV for it. I have Algo fatigue. Each topic area is a channel (DEVTV, SOLDER, RETRO, ORBIT, ...), plus HN Prime (the top 400), a music channel, and Late Night on ch 99, which only broadcasts 11pm-5am your local time and shows color bars otherwise. Similar to HackerTube it was built with Claude Code in a few hours. All credit for the data goes to HackerTube. Happy to hear channel ideas. — official record
